technical.summary: Bullish structure with strong moving average alignment and recent momentum (hull flip, tema cross) but weakened by low ADX trend strength, overbought stochastics, negative CMF, and neutral sector backdrop—suitable for swing entry with tight stops but not high-conviction.

fundamental.summary: CI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 70 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) and bearish sentiment (53.5%) present contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (372.16) combined with flat yield curve and macro_score of -3 creates severely unfavourable conditions; 70-day earnings window adds moderate event risk but is secondary to acute volatility stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Technical structure shows bullish alignment (price above major MAs, hull flip, tema cross, supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment creating a contrarian buy opportunity in a crisis VIX regime.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX 372.16 crisis, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), fundamentals are absent (no insider/institutional conviction, earnings risk in 70 days), and overbought technicals (stoch 73.97, negative CMF) with weak trend strength (ADX 15.91) signal pullback risk without conviction support.
